title: Harvest Record Checklist
subtitle: Harvest Record: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Harvest Record Checklist covers crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff. The harvest operations owner records Harvest Record criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Harvest Record Checklist keeps Harvest Record exceptions visible until the harvest operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Harvest Record Checklist at field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location. Document crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff identity before Harvest Record begins. Compare crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff findings with stated Harvest Record criteria; route unresolved Harvest Record issues to farm production reviewer.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Harvest Record, identify responsible parties, field, block, harvest zone, loading point, and receiving or cooling location, and the linked crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff source.

fields.label: Farm, field, block, crop, and variety
Harvest date, crew, supervisor, and lot
Container, trailer, load, quantity, and destination

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Harvest Record facts for crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Field, lot, crop, crew, or container
Harvest, handling, quantity, or custody criterion
Observed time, condition, code, or record

blocks.label: Harvest Record inspection checks
items: Crew, tool, container, and hygiene readiness
Transport, cooling, receiving, rejection, and loss

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Harvest Record, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Harvest Operations Owner preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Harvest Record when lot identity, crop condition, quantity, cooling, or receiving custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Harvest Record proof and route unresolved crop, field or block, harvest crew, container, quantity, condition, lot, and receiving handoff scope to harvest operations owner.
